item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Anika's battery pack connected to a charger plug. After charging, she uses the same pack in her toy car many times, then charges it again.

Which claim about this battery is correct?

options.A: It is rechargeable because it can be charged again and reused many times.
options.B: It is rechargeable because it ran the toy several times before going flat, even with no charging.
options.C: It is single-use because any battery that powers a toy must be thrown away after one day.
options.D: It is single-use because the diagram shows wires, so charging cannot restore it.
